description: A platform reached only along a 0.5u ledge (a pixel walk, -exploits only), and a crouch tunnel whose floor is crossed by a 0.5u trim strip that the default walk must still cross.

must_visible.why: P's top: only an eye on P or on the ledge (160u up) sees it

must_reach.why: ledge step 3: a pixel walk, standable with -exploits
P's top: along the ledge with -exploits
tunnel floor B: crouch-walk over the trim

notes: Ledge 0.5u deep, steps z 48..144, P top 160; trim 0.5u in a 40u tunnel.

default_must_reach.why: tunnel floor B: the 0.5u trim between A and B is not a pixel walk

default_must_not_reach.why: ledge step 3: 0.53u wide, a pixel walk
P's top: reached only along the ledge
